# descope_twilio_core_connector (Resource)

Manages a Twilio Core connector and its configuration in a Descope project. Send text messages and place voice calls through Twilio.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_sid` (String) The Twilio account SID.
- `name` (String) A custom name for your connector.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Descope project that the connector belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The Twilio API key. Set together with an API secret instead of an auth token.
- `api_secret` (String, Sensitive) The Twilio API secret. Set together with an API key instead of an auth token.
- `auth_token` (String, Sensitive) The Twilio auth token. Set either this or an API key and secret pair.
- `description` (String) A description of what your connector is used for.
- `from_phone` (String) The phone number that text messages are sent from. Set either this or a messaging service SID.
- `from_phone_voice` (String) The phone number that voice calls are placed from.
- `messaging_service_sid` (String) The Twilio messaging service SID to send text messages through. Set either this or a from phone number.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
